instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Huda Lafta Majeed
subject: 01_Cyber_Security
topic: Mathematical models of segmentation and layered security

questions.question: How is the risk of a single segment expressed?
questions.question_ar: كيف يُعبَّر عن خطر قطاع واحد؟
options: Threat probability divided by the vulnerability score.
The average of threat probability and vulnerability.
Threat probability times the vulnerability score.
Threat probability plus the vulnerability score.
options_ar: احتمال التهديد مقسوماً على درجة الثغرة.
options_en: Threat probability divided by the vulnerability score.
The average of threat probability and vulnerability.
Threat probability times the vulnerability score.
Threat probability plus the vulnerability score.
questions.explanation: Each segment carries a threat probability and a vulnerability score, and their product is that segment's risk.
questions.explanation_ar: كل قطاع عنده احتمال تهديد ودرجة ثغرة، وحاصل ضربهما هو خطر ذلك القطاع.

questions.question: How is the aggregate network risk computed?
questions.question_ar: كيف تُحسب المخاطر الكلية للشبكة؟
options: The sum of the per-segment risks.
The product of the per-segment risks.
The maximum per-segment risk alone.
The average of the per-segment risks.
options_en: The sum of the per-segment risks.
The product of the per-segment risks.
The maximum per-segment risk alone.
The average of the per-segment risks.
questions.explanation: Risks across segments add, because each one is an exposure that exists in parallel rather than in sequence.
questions.explanation_ar: المخاطر عبر القطاعات تُجمع، لأن كل واحد تعرّض موجود بالتوازي مو بالتتابع.

questions.question: How is the effective risk after segmentation expressed?
questions.question_ar: كيف يُعبَّر عن المخاطر الفعلية بعد التقسيم؟
options: The segmentation factor plus the aggregate risk.
The aggregate risk divided by the segmentation factor.
The aggregate risk minus the segmentation factor.
The segmentation factor times the aggregate risk.
options_ar: المخاطر الكلية مقسومة على معامل التقسيم.
options_en: The segmentation factor plus the aggregate risk.
The aggregate risk divided by the segmentation factor.
The aggregate risk minus the segmentation factor.
The segmentation factor times the aggregate risk.
questions.explanation: The factor represents segmentation efficiency, so it scales the aggregate exposure up or down.
questions.explanation_ar: المعامل يمثّل كفاءة التقسيم، فهو يعيّر التعرّض الكلي صعوداً أو نزولاً.

questions.question: What does a segmentation factor of one mean?
questions.question_ar: شنو يعني معامل تقسيم قيمته واحد؟
options: That the segments are all equally vulnerable.
That no isolation exists, so the full risk remains.
That isolation is perfect and risk disappears.
That the risk has doubled from the baseline.
options_en: That the segments are all equally vulnerable.
That no isolation exists, so the full risk remains.
That isolation is perfect and risk disappears.
That the risk has doubled from the baseline.
questions.explanation: The factor sits between zero and one, and at one it leaves the aggregate risk untouched.
questions.explanation_ar: المعامل بين الصفر والواحد، وعند الواحد يترك المخاطر الكلية بلا مساس.

questions.question: What does a segmentation factor approaching zero indicate?
questions.question_ar: شنو يدلّ عليه معامل تقسيم يقترب من الصفر؟
options: That every segment is fully exposed.
That the risk model has broken down.
Near-total isolation, as in micro segmentation.
That the network has no segments at all.
options_ar: عزل شبه تام، كما في التقسيم الدقيق.
options_en: That every segment is fully exposed.
That the risk model has broken down.
Near-total isolation, as in micro segmentation.
That the network has no segments at all.
questions.explanation: Micro segmentation in virtualised systems drives the factor close to zero, which collapses the aggregate figure.
questions.explanation_ar: التقسيم الدقيق بالأنظمة الافتراضية يدفع المعامل قرب الصفر، وهذا ينهار بالرقم الكلي.

questions.question: Which technique pushes the segmentation factor closest to zero?
questions.question_ar: أي تقنية تدفع معامل التقسيم أقرب للصفر؟
options: Micro segmentation at the workload level.
VLAN separation inside one switch.
Subnetting a single address range.
A perimeter firewall at the edge.
options_en: Micro segmentation at the workload level.
VLAN separation inside one switch.
Subnetting a single address range.
A perimeter firewall at the edge.
questions.explanation: The finer the boundary, the less unnecessary communication survives, which is exactly what the factor is measuring.
questions.explanation_ar: كل ما كان الحدّ أدق، قلّ الاتصال غير الضروري الباقي، وهذا بالضبط اللي يقيسه المعامل.

questions.question: How is the probability that an attack succeeds across all layers expressed?
questions.question_ar: كيف يُعبَّر عن احتمال نجاح الهجوم عبر كل الطبقات؟
options: The sum of each layer's failure probability.
The product of each layer's success probability.
The average of the failure probabilities.
The product of each layer's failure probability.
options_ar: حاصل ضرب احتمال نجاح كل طبقة.
حاصل ضرب احتمال فشل كل طبقة.
options_en: The sum of each layer's failure probability.
The product of each layer's success probability.
The average of the failure probabilities.
The product of each layer's failure probability.
questions.explanation: For the attack to succeed every layer must fail, so the individual failure probabilities multiply.
questions.explanation_ar: حتى ينجح الهجوم لازم كل طبقة تفشل، فاحتمالات الفشل المنفردة تتضارب.

questions.question: What does the symbol for each layer's probability represent?
questions.question_ar: شنو يمثّل رمز احتمال كل طبقة؟
options: The number of controls inside this layer.
The probability that this particular layer fails.
The probability that this layer detects correctly.
The cost of operating this layer per year.
options_ar: احتمال كشف تلك الطبقة بشكل صحيح.
options_en: The number of controls inside this layer.
The probability that this particular layer fails.
The probability that this layer detects correctly.
The cost of operating this layer per year.
questions.explanation: It is a failure probability from the attacker's point of view, which is why success requires multiplying them.
questions.explanation_ar: هو احتمال فشل من منظور المهاجم، ولهذا النجاح يتطلّب ضربها.

questions.question: With an average layer failure probability of 0.2 across five layers, what is the success probability?
questions.question_ar: بمتوسط احتمال فشل 0.2 عبر خمس طبقات، شنو احتمال النجاح؟
options: About one percent, the failure probability divided by five.
About eighty percent, the complement of failure.
About 0.032 percent, since the fifth power of 0.2 is tiny.
About twenty percent, the average failure probability.
options_ar: حوالي واحد بالمئة، احتمال الفشل مقسوماً على خمسة.
حوالي 0.032 بالمئة، لأن 0.2 أسّ خمسة رقم ضئيل.
حوالي عشرين بالمئة، متوسط احتمال الفشل.
options_en: About one percent, the failure probability divided by five.
About eighty percent, the complement of failure.
About 0.032 percent, since the fifth power of 0.2 is tiny.
About twenty percent, the average failure probability.
questions.explanation: Raising 0.2 to the fifth power gives 0.00032, which is 0.032 percent, a reduction no additive model would produce.
questions.explanation_ar: رفع 0.2 للأس خمسة يعطي 0.00032، أي 0.032 بالمئة، وهو تخفيض ما ينتجه أي نموذج جمعي.

questions.question: Why is the reduction described as exponential rather than linear?
questions.question_ar: ليش يوصف التخفيض بأنه أُسّي مو خطي؟
options: Because each extra layer multiplies by the same fraction again.
Because the number of layers grows exponentially over time.
Because the attack probability is measured on a log scale.
Because the risk is divided equally among the layers.
options_ar: لأن كل طبقة إضافية تضرب بنفس الكسر مرة ثانية.
لأن عدد الطبقات ينمو أُسّياً مع الوقت.
لأن احتمال الهجوم يُقاس بمقياس لوغاريتمي.
لأن الخطر يُقسَّم بالتساوي على الطبقات.
options_en: Because each extra layer multiplies by the same fraction again.
Because the number of layers grows exponentially over time.
Because the attack probability is measured on a log scale.
Because the risk is divided equally among the layers.
questions.explanation: A constant multiplier applied repeatedly is the definition of geometric decay, which is what makes depth pay off so sharply.
questions.explanation_ar: مضروب ثابت يُطبَّق مراراً هو تعريف التلاشي الهندسي، وهذا اللي يخلي العمق مربحاً بهذي الحدة.

questions.question: Why does the defence formula multiply one-minus-reduction while the attack formula multiplies failure?
questions.question_ar: ليش معادلة الدفاع تضرب واحد ناقص الخفض، ومعادلة الهجوم تضرب الفشل؟
options: They are the same formula written with different letters.
One applies to networks, the other only to hosts.
One is measured in money, the other in probability.
One tracks what survives, the other tracks what must go wrong.
options_ar: واحدة تتتبّع ما يبقى، والثانية ما لازم يفشل.
options_en: They are the same formula written with different letters.
One applies to networks, the other only to hosts.
One is measured in money, the other in probability.
One tracks what survives, the other tracks what must go wrong.
questions.explanation: Defensive layering asks how much risk survives each control, while attack modelling asks how likely every layer is to fail in sequence.
questions.explanation_ar: الطبقات الدفاعية تسأل شكثر خطر يبقى بعد كل ضابط، ونمذجة الهجوم تسأل شكثر محتمل تفشل كل طبقة بالتتابع.

questions.question: How is micro segmentation effectiveness expressed?
questions.question_ar: كيف تُعبَّر فعالية التقسيم الدقيق؟
options: Allowed communications times total communications.
Total communications minus allowed, over total.
Allowed communications over total communications.
Total communications divided by allowed ones.
options_ar: إجمالي الاتصالات ناقص المسموح، على الإجمالي.
الاتصالات المسموح بها على إجمالي الاتصالات.
options_en: Allowed communications times total communications.
Total communications minus allowed, over total.
Allowed communications over total communications.
Total communications divided by allowed ones.
questions.explanation: It measures the fraction of communication that policy removed, so it rises as unnecessary traffic is contained.
questions.explanation_ar: يقيس كسر الاتصال اللي أزالته السياسة، فيرتفع كل ما احتُوي ترافيك غير ضروري.

questions.question: What does a high micro segmentation effectiveness score indicate?
questions.question_ar: شنو تدلّ عليه فعالية عالية للتقسيم الدقيق؟
options: That the segmentation policy has not been applied.
That the network has more edges than before.
That most unnecessary communication has been contained.
That most communication is still allowed through.
options_ar: إن الشبكة عندها حواف أكثر من قبل.
إن معظم الاتصال غير الضروري احتُوي.
إن معظم الاتصال ما زال مسموحاً.
options_en: That the segmentation policy has not been applied.
That the network has more edges than before.
That most unnecessary communication has been contained.
That most communication is still allowed through.
questions.explanation: The score is the share of conversations that policy denied, so a high value means the policy is actually narrowing the graph.
questions.explanation_ar: النتيجة هي حصة المحادثات اللي رفضتها السياسة، فالقيمة العالية تعني إن السياسة فعلاً تضيّق المخطّط.

questions.question: Which four states does the Zero Trust Markov model use?
questions.question_ar: أي أربع حالات يستخدمها نموذج Markov للثقة الصفرية؟
options: Request, verification, conditional grant and denial.
Login, logout, idle timeout and session expiry.
Connect, transfer, close and reset the socket.
Encrypt, decrypt, sign and verify a message.
options_ar: الدخول والخروج والمهلة الخاملة وانتهاء الجلسة.
options_en: Request, verification, conditional grant and denial.
Login, logout, idle timeout and session expiry.
Connect, transfer, close and reset the socket.
Encrypt, decrypt, sign and verify a message.
questions.explanation: The chain runs from an access request through verification to either conditional access or denial and quarantine.
questions.explanation_ar: السلسلة تمشي من طلب وصول عبر التحقّق إلى إما وصول مشروط أو رفض وحجر.

questions.question: How is the steady-state distribution of that chain defined?
questions.question_ar: كيف يُعرَّف توزيع الحالة المستقرة لتلك السلسلة؟
options: The vector equal to the transition matrix inverted.
The sum of all transition probabilities in a row.
The initial state multiplied by the number of steps.
The vector equal to itself times the transition matrix.
options_ar: المتجه اللي يساوي مقلوب مصفوفة الانتقال.
مجموع كل احتمالات الانتقال بسطر واحد.
المتجه اللي يساوي نفسه مضروباً بمصفوفة الانتقال.
options_en: The vector equal to the transition matrix inverted.
The sum of all transition probabilities in a row.
The initial state multiplied by the number of steps.
The vector equal to itself times the transition matrix.
questions.explanation: A steady state is a distribution that the transition matrix leaves unchanged, and its entries must sum to one.
questions.explanation_ar: الحالة المستقرة توزيع تتركه مصفوفة الانتقال بلا تغيير، ومجموع مدخلاته لازم يساوي واحد.

questions.question: What do the transition probabilities in that chain reflect?
questions.question_ar: شنو تعكسه احتمالات الانتقال بتلك السلسلة؟
options: The cost of the identity provider licence.
The rigour of the verification step.
The bandwidth of the internal network.
The number of users in each department.
options_en: The cost of the identity provider licence.
The rigour of the verification step.
The bandwidth of the internal network.
The number of users in each department.
questions.explanation: Stricter verification changes how often sessions reach the granted state rather than being refused.
questions.explanation_ar: التحقّق الأصرم يغيّر كم مرة توصل الجلسات لحالة المنح بدل ما تُرفض.

questions.question: What is minimised when verification is made strict?
questions.question_ar: شنو يُقلَّل لمّا يصير التحقّق صارماً؟
options: The encryption overhead per session.
The number of segments in the network.
The steady-state probability of compromise.
The number of users who need access.
options_en: The encryption overhead per session.
The number of segments in the network.
The steady-state probability of compromise.
The number of users who need access.
questions.explanation: Strict verification lowers the long-run chance of landing in the granted state for the wrong principal.
questions.explanation_ar: التحقّق الصارم ينزّل الاحتمال طويل الأمد للوصول لحالة المنح لهوية خاطئة.

questions.question: What does a service mesh such as Istio enforce?
questions.question_ar: شنو يفرض service mesh مثل Istio؟
options: Encrypted, authenticated east-west communication.
Physical separation of the container hosts.
Routing between autonomous systems.
Certificate revocation for the public web.
options_ar: اتصالاً مشفّراً وموثّقاً بين الشرق والغرب.
options_en: Encrypted, authenticated east-west communication.
Physical separation of the container hosts.
Routing between autonomous systems.
Certificate revocation for the public web.
questions.explanation: The mesh carries policy and mutual authentication into the traffic between services, which is where modern attacks actually operate.
questions.explanation_ar: الـ mesh يحمل السياسة والمصادقة المتبادلة إلى الترافيك بين الخدمات، وهناك تشتغل الهجمات الحديثة فعلاً.

questions.question: What does cloud-native segmentation extend to?
questions.question_ar: إلى شنو يمتد التقسيم السحابي المنشأ؟
options: Routers, switches and hubs.
Users, groups and roles.
Certificates, keys and tokens.
Containers, pods and microservices.
options_en: Routers, switches and hubs.
Users, groups and roles.
Certificates, keys and tokens.
Containers, pods and microservices.
questions.explanation: Segmentation follows the workload, so in cloud-native estates the boundary is drawn around pods and services.
questions.explanation_ar: التقسيم يتبع حِمل العمل، فببيئات السحابة الحدّ يُرسم حول الـ pods والخدمات.

questions.question: Through what is micro segmentation often enforced?
questions.question_ar: عبر شنو يُفرض التقسيم الدقيق غالباً؟
options: Manual firewall rule reviews.
Software-defined networking.
Static access control lists on routers.
Physical cabling changes in the rack.
options_ar: قوائم تحكّم وصول ثابتة على الموجّهات.
options_en: Manual firewall rule reviews.
Software-defined networking.
Static access control lists on routers.
Physical cabling changes in the rack.
questions.explanation: Per-workload policy changes too often for hardware rules, so the control plane has to be software.
questions.explanation_ar: سياسة كل حِمل تتغيّر أكثر من أن تتحمّلها قواعد العتاد، فمستوى التحكّم لازم يكون برمجياً.
